reason: I already find openings through my placement cell and the apps I use, so another tool has to save me time right away. Hosting it and setting up paid provider credentials feels like too much work while I am trying to get placed.
objection: Why should I set up and maintain this when my existing channels already show me opportunities?
would_change_my_mind: A simple phone-friendly demo that brings together current eligible campus and internship posts without requiring me to host it or configure keys.
